name: code-type-classifier
body: The ingestor's code-type classifier: maps a source path plus language to a code type (src/test/generated/external), replacing built-ins with apg/config.json rules when present. Implemented today by classify_code_type / builtin_code_type in src/classify.rs; extended with .js/.jsx/.mjs/.cjs rules for JS generated/bundled output, with .md/.markdown docs rules (a docs code type for ordinary markdown, generated/external segment rules still winning), and with a Python arm: test = *_test.py / test_* / *.test.py or a test|tests|__tests__ segment; generated = __pycache__|gen|generated; external = vendor|third_party|thirdparty. The py arm carries no `.pyi` filename rule: hand-written / typeshed `.pyi` API stubs are source and classify `src`, matching the TS arm's `.d.ts` handling; `generated` is decided by path segment only, so a `.pyi` under gen/generated still classifies generated. `site-packages` carries NO arm: it is a discovery exclusion and is never a scan root (domain.constraint.python-exclusions), so no site-packages path reaches the classifier and it is never classified.
